import os import sqlite3 from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = os.environ.get("APP_SECRET", "dev-secret") DB_PATH = "db.sqlite3" # HTML templates UPLOAD_FORM = """ Upload Recipe

Upload New Recipe

""" RECIPE_PAGE = """ {{ title }}

{{ title }}

Ingredients

    {% for ing in ingredients %}
  • {{ ing }}
    • {% endfor %}

{{ instructions }}

{% if avg_rating is not none %}
Average Rating: {{ avg_rating|round(1) }} / 5
{% endif %}

Comments

{% for comment in comments %}
{{ comment }}
{% endfor %}
Back to Recipes """ INDEX_PAGE = """ Recipe Sharing App

Recipe Overview

Upload a new recipe

{% for r in recipes %}

{{ r.title }}

Rating: {% if r.avg_rating is not none %}{{ r.avg_rating|round(1) }} / 5{% else %}No ratings yet{% endif %}

Comments: {{ r.comments_count }}

{% else %}

No recipes found.

{% endfor %}
""" def init_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recipes ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, ingredients TEXT NOT NULL, instructions TEXT NOT NULL, comments TEXT DEFAULT '', avg_rating REAL DEFAULT NULL, ratings_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )''') c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id TEXT, comment TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes(id) )''') conn.commit() conn.close() init_db() def get_recipe(recipe_id): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row c = conn.cursor() c.execute("SELECT * FROM recipes WHERE id = ?", (recipe_id,)) row = c.fetchone() conn.close() if row is None: return None recipe = dict(row) # Parse ingredients string back to list try: recipe['ingredients'] = eval(recipe['ingredients']) if recipe['ingredients'] else [] except: recipe['ingredients'] = [] return recipe @app.route('/') def index(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute("SELECT id, title, avg_rating, ratings_count FROM recipes") rows = c.fetchall() conn.close() recipes = [{'id': r[0], 'title': r[1], 'avg_rating': r[2], 'comments_count': r[3]} for r in rows] return render_template_string(INDEX_PAGE, recipes=recipes) @app.route('/recipes/upload', methods=['GET', 'POST']) def upload_recipe(): if request.method == 'GET': return render_template_string(UPLOAD_FORM) title = request.form.get('title', '').strip() ingredients_input = request.form.get('ingredients', '').strip() instructions = request.form.get('instructions', '').strip() if not title or not ingredients_input or not instructions: return jsonify({"error": "Invalid input: all fields required"}), 400 ingredients = [ing.strip() for ing in ingredients_input.split(',') if ing.strip()] recipe_id = str(uuid.uuid4()) if False else str(hash(title + str(datetime.now()))) % 100000 # Use UUID for simplicity import uuid recipe_id = str(uuid.uuid4()) # Store ingredients as string for SQLite simplicity ingredients_str = str(ingredients) conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute("INSERT INTO recipes (id, title, ingredients, instructions) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", (recipe_id, title, ingredients_str, instructions)) conn.commit() conn.close() return jsonify({"id": recipe_id, "title": title, "message": "Recipe created successfully"}), 201 @app.route('/recipes/') def get_recipe_page(recipe_id): recipe = get_recipe(recipe_id) if recipe is None: return jsonify({"error": "Recipe not found"}), 404 # Get comments for this recipe conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute("SELECT comment FROM comments WHERE recipe_id = ?", (recipe_id,)) comments = [row[0] for row in c.fetchall()] # Calculate average rating from stored data (we're not storing ratings in this simplified version) # For now, we'll just show no rating info or basic info avg_rating = recipe.get('avg_rating') conn.close() return render_template_string(RECIPE_PAGE, title=recipe['title'], ingredients=recipe.get('ingredients', []), instructions=recipe['instructions'], comments=comments, avg_rating=avg_rating) @app.route('/recipes//comments', methods=['POST']) def add_comment(recipe_id): recipe = get_recipe(recipe_id) if recipe is None: return jsonify({"error": "Recipe not found"}), 404 data = request.get_json(silent=True) if not data or not data.get('comment'): return jsonify({"error": "Invalid input: comment required"}), 400 comment_text = data['comment'].strip() if not comment_text: return jsonify({"error": "Invalid input: comment required"}), 400 conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute("INSERT INTO comments (recipe_id, comment) VALUES (?, ?)", (recipe_id, comment_text)) # Update comments count in recipes table c.execute("UPDATE recipes SET comments_count = comments_count + 1 WHERE id = ?", (recipe_id,)) conn.commit() conn.close() return jsonify({"message": "Comment added successfully"}), 201 @app.route('/recipes//ratings', methods=['POST']) def rate_recipe(recipe_id): recipe = get_recipe(recipe_id) if recipe is None: return jsonify({"error": "Recipe not found"}), 404 data = request.get_json(silent=True) if not data or not data.get('rating'): return jsonify({"error": "Invalid input: rating required"}), 400 try: rating = int(data['rating']) except (ValueError, TypeError): return jsonify({"error": "Invalid input: rating must be an integer"}), 400 if rating < 1 or rating > 5: return jsonify({"error": "Invalid input: rating must be between 1 and 5"}), 400 # Update average rating conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() # Get current rating info c.execute("SELECT avg_rating, ratings_count FROM recipes WHERE id = ?", (recipe_id,)) row = c.fetchone() current_avg = row[0] if row and row[0] is not None else 0.0 current_count = row[1] if row and row[1] is not None else 0 new_count = current_count + 1 new_avg = (current_avg * current_count + rating) / new_count c.execute("UPDATE recipes SET avg_rating = ?, ratings_count = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_avg, new_count, recipe_id)) conn.commit() conn.close() return jsonify({"message": "Rating added successfully", "newAverageRating": round(new_avg, 2)}), 201 if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
